title: Brand Book & Guidelines Design in Tashkent
description: Brand book design in Tashkent: clear rules for your logo, colours, typography and applications, so every designer and printer gets your brand right. Ask us.
lead: A brand book is the rulebook of your brand: how to use the logo, colours, typography and graphics, with examples of what to do and what to avoid. OneBranding prepares it as part of its branding packages, from $1,900.
intro: A brand rarely stays with the people who designed it. Your marketing team, printers, sign makers, a social media agency and your website developer all work with it, and without written rules each of them improvises. A brand book gives everyone the same answers: which logo version goes where, which colours to use, how much space to leave and what a layout should look like.

We write the brand book on the basis of your strategy and identity, and illustrate every rule with your real applications rather than abstract examples. You receive it together with the final files and templates, so it can be used from the first day. If your brand does not have an identity yet, we design the logo and identity first and then set down their rules.

includes.title: What a brand book includes
items: Brand essentials: idea, positioning and tone of voice
Logo versions, clear space, minimum sizes and misuse examples
Colour palette with values for print and screen
Graphic elements, patterns and imagery style
Layout rules shown on real applications
The brand book file, final logo files and source files

process.title: How we create a brand book

steps.name: Brief and research
steps.text: We study your strategy, identity and current materials, and every place where your brand appears.

steps.name: Structure
steps.text: We define what the brand book must cover for your business, from the logo to packaging or signage.

steps.name: Rules and design
steps.text: We write the rules and design the pages, showing each rule on your real applications.

steps.name: Refinement
steps.text: Each stage includes rounds of revisions with your feedback; you approve it before we move on.

steps.name: Hand-over
steps.text: You receive the brand book together with the final files, the agreed templates and the source files.

timeline.title: How long it takes
timeline.text: A brand book is usually created together with a focused identity, which takes 2 to 6 weeks. A full brand system with naming, packaging or a website takes longer. We agree on the timeline before we start.

items.q: How much does a brand book cost in Tashkent?
items.a: A brand book is part of our branding packages: Launch Base from $1,900, One Pro from $2,900 and Global ultimate from $5,900. The final price depends on what the brand book has to cover and is agreed after the brief.

items.q: What is a brand book and what does it contain?
items.a: It is the guide to using your brand. It usually covers the brand idea, logo versions and their rules, colours, typography, graphic elements, imagery and examples on real applications, along with the mistakes to avoid.

items.q: What is the difference between a brand book and brand guidelines?
items.a: The terms overlap. Guidelines usually mean a shorter, practical guide to the logo and identity; a brand book also explains the brand’s idea, positioning and tone of voice. We decide together which format your business needs.

items.q: Can you make a brand book for our existing logo?
items.a: Yes. We first review your logo and identity: if they are consistent, we document them; if they have gaps, we suggest how to close them, so the rules are worth following. The scope is agreed after the brief.

items.q: In what format do we receive the brand book?
items.a: As a digital document that is easy to share with your team and contractors, together with the final logo files in vector, print and web formats, the agreed templates and the source files.

cta.title: Put your brand’s rules in writing
cta.text: Tell us about your brand and we will come back with a proposal for your brand book: scope, timeline and price.
